handoff.objective: Run exact P-224 split and Curve448 nonsplit/cofactor-aware comparisons of the implicit Dickson factor-base interface.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the membership/decomposition interface remains exact on the two published comparison curves, including subgroup rejection and repeated coordinates.
constraints: Local-only implementation correctness, no scientific performance trial or official state transition.
Use current reviews/local-custody-exception.json; public disclosure approval is pending. Normal pushed-handoff condition is not met; record the exception.
Own only comparisons/p224-curve448/**; original native outputs immutable. No Git/PR or uploads.
P-224 uses split multiplicative cosets because v2(p-1)=96; Curve448 uses norm-one torus cosets and exact r-subgroup filtering with cofactor4.
Use deterministic small fixed domain sizes (e.g. S=16 and32, extending only to64 if empty), generic c!=+-2, complete root/domain checks and exact point decompositions.
Compare actual accepted canonical base cardinality, not just chain size; retain rejected lifts and cofactor exclusions.
Constructed positive, base cancellation and unrelated public-generator controls are correctness only. No uniform-target yield claim.
deliverables: Portable source, exact parameter/curve/group identities and complete domain/point-sum certificates.
At least one independently implemented full point-decomposition comparison on each nonempty base; include repeated-coordinate support.
report.md, result.json, diagram.svg, commands and source hashes.
completion_gate: Published fields and prime-subgroup inclusion explicitly checked; no secret scalar supplied to search.
Complete roots and complete finite-domain decomposition sets checked or unknown outcome preserved.
Every output and failure retained, preferably files<64KiB.
handoff.return_format: Exact counts/certificates, caveats and comparison implications without performance verdict.
